spec.situation_desc: needs a replacement for a lost card

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Hannah speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi Hannah, I’m Kwame MacLeod. I’ve lost my debit card and need a replacement.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that’s happened, Kwame. I can help with that. Before I look at your account, could you confirm your date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And just to check, your full name is Kwame MacLeod?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s all verified. I’ll arrange to cancel the lost card and request a replacement. There’s never a fee for replacing a lost card—sorry, I’ve got that wrong. A replacement fee may apply, so I’ll check the charge before submitting the request.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right, thanks for letting me know.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I can see the card ending 4812. Is that the one you’ve lost?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll cancel that card so it can’t be used, then submit the replacement request to your address. You’ll need to use a new PIN with the replacement; the instructions will come with it. I can’t confirm exactly when it’ll arrive, but we’ll send it by post once the request is processed.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: So, to summarise: I’ll cancel the card ending 4812, check whether the fee applies, and request a replacement to your address. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Kwame. I’ll take care of the request now.
